messages:
Anika: Quick sync — legal just asked for the final marketplace/partner announcement assets for Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB bundle. We need a go/no-go by EOD Friday. Can ops confirm connector certification + demo readiness?
Sam: On it. Ops checklist: cert tests, example ingest, perf smoke, telemetry hooked to our metrics. ETA Thurs afternoon for limited smoke.
Diego: For Databricks connector: unit tests pass, need to run e2e with Delta sample. I'll queue a job on staging cluster now.
Priya: Snowflake side: we still have the ACL/role docs pending. Also need the Snowflake listing tile screenshot and sample SQL snippet for docs. I'll draft the SQL today.
Marta: Marketing needs 30s gif of the live demo + one hero screenshot for the marketplace card. Can someone capture the demo once Diego's e2e run is stable?
Anika: Great. Priorities: 1) certification smoke (ops) 2) demo recording (product+eng) 3) marketplace assets (marcom) 4) partner legal checklist (I have a call with Snow PM @ 4pm).
Sam: integrations-bot just ran cert probe: "ConnectorCertJob #482 -> failures: 2 flaky tests (auth timeout), rest green". I'll re-run with increased timeout.
integrations-bot: job details: https://ci.redwood.local/build/482
Diego: Re-run started: `./scripts/e2e-run --connector databricks --dataset delta-sample --retry 2`
Priya: Draft SQL for Snowflake sample: ```SELECT id, summary FROM redwood_demo.public.documents WHERE MATCH(summary, 'vector') LIMIT 10;``` Use the `redwood_demo` schema in the sample.
Sam: Ops checklist (quick): 
- cert smoke ✅ except auth timeout
- telemetry events ✅ (ingest.start, ingest.end, embed.latency)
- marketplace package zip ✅ (manifest + icons + readme)
- demo env ✅ (staging cluster w/ 2 GPUs)
- legal notes: privacy blurb pending
Diego: Demo capture plan: I'll run a short Jupyter notebook showing ingest -> embedding -> query against Milvus on staging. Will record with `ffmpeg` and share raw + trimmed clip.
Marta: I'll build the gif once you drop raw. Also need a one-liner for the marketplace blurb (marketing) and 3 bullet points for the doc.
Anika: Can we confirm the partner co-announcement cadence? Snowflake prefers next Tuesday window. Databricks is flexible same week. If we hit cert by Fri, marketing can pipeline assets and partner comms.
Priya: Legal asked for data handling text, send them the sample privacy paragraph: "Connectors do not persist customer data outside allocated storage; token exchange uses customer-managed keys where available." Is that OK?
Sam: That's the agreed phrasing from the privacy team last week. I'll attach the formal snippet to the listing.
Diego: e2e finished: all tests green, re-run fixed timeout. `ingest` took ~22s for 10k rows. Embedding step 4.3s per batch.
Anika: Fantastic. Two asks before EOD Friday: 1) Diego — upload demo clip + raw; 2) Priya — Snowflake SQL + screenshot + privacy blurb. Marta and Marketing will finalize assets.
Marta: Noted. I'll slot the gif + hero into the marketplace template and ping legal for final sign-off.
integrations-bot: scheduled reminder -> "marketplace-announce-deadline" at 1700000000
Sam: I'll post a short runbook in the thread once I've attached the cert logs and the final package.
Priya: Attaching SQL screenshot now: https://redwood.internal/attachments/snow-sql-sample.png
Diego: Uploading demo: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/demos/connector-demo-1735556666.mp4 (raw)
Marta: Got it, starting gif render.
Anika: Thanks team — I'll sync with partner PM after their 4pm and update here. If anything blocks, call me directly. :thumbsup:
Sam: thx, will keep eyes on CI and legal thread.
Diego: thumbs up
Priya: ✅
Marta: ✅
Anika: last note — include a short troubleshooting snippet in the docs for the common auth timeout: ```export REDWOOD_TIMEOUT=60 && ./connector start```
